items.name: Melbourne Mini Saturday 2022
items.information:

items.name: Lyttelton Autumn 2022

venue.name: https://ccc.govt.nz/culture-and-community/community-facilities/venues-for-hire/lyttelton-recreation-centre/
venue.address: Lyttelton Recreation Centre, 25 Winchester Street, Lyttelton, 8082

items.information: Lyttelton Autumn 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Back To Cubing Chiriquí 2022
items.information:
Español
•	“Back To Cubing Chiriquí 2022” será la tercera competencia oficial en Chiriquí.
•	Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA. Busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en Panamá de la manera más segura posible.
•	Se aceptará un máximo de 1 acompañante por competidor.
•	El uso de la mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
•	Los resultados preliminares, y los clasificados a rondas posteriores, se podrán ver casi en tiempo real en WCA Live.
English
•	“Back To Cubing Chiriquí 2022” will be the third official competition in Chiriquí.
•	With national biosafety protocols and those established by the WCA. We seek to mantain the development of speedcubing in Panama in the safest way possible.
•	A maximum of 1 companion per competitor is allowed.
•	The use of masks is mandatory at all time during the competition.
•	Preliminary results, and those qualify to subsequent rounds, can be viewed in near real-time on WCA-Live.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0VTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--335b7db6f37ac1a39c19c5dbb58bd1257b339f8b/Back%20To%20Cubing%20Chiriqui%202022.png)

items.name: Kubkvarna 2022
items.information:
Välkomna till Kubkvarna 2022, en tävling som ännu en gång välkomnar er alla till härliga Folkets Park i Huskvarna.
Alla är välkomna att delta, vare sig du löser kuben på 10 minuter eller 6 sekunder.

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen.
Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är **gratis**, mer information finns under fliken SveKub, och på [SveKubs hemsida](https://svekub.se/bli-medlem/).


------

Welcome to Kubkvarna 2022, a competition that once again welcomes you all to the lovely Folket Park in Huskvarna.
Everyone is welcome to compete, whether you solve the cube in 10 minutes or 6 seconds.

Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition.
Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. Membership is available for everyone with a  Swedish personal number, and it is **free**. Read more on the SveKub tab, or on [SveKub's website](https://svekub.se/en/bli-medlem/).

items.name: PBQtah Winter 2022
items.information:
* This is a "Please Be Quiet" competition, so standard speedsolving events will not be held.
* Each competitor is only allowed to bring one guest with them to the competition.
* Please review the [COVID Precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQtahWinter2022#17172-covid-precautions) before registering.
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue.

items.name: NA Stadium Series - Green Bay 2022
items.information:
We are proud to announce the first competition in the North American Stadium Series! Our first stop is historical Lambeau Field. This competition will offer a very unique experience for speedcubers and football fans alike. You won't want to miss it! Please see below and other tabs for very important information.

## Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
